content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms
content_sections.text: The engagement is purely contractual in nature with fixed monthly remuneration and defined service conditions. The appointment is for a period of one year for Ex-Servicemen (ESM) and 11 months for Civilian Candidates. It is renewable for an additional period of one year for ESM and 11 months for Civilian Candidates only till attaining the maximum age, subject to candidate performance and other conditions. As per the policy of Central Organisation (ECHS), AG's Branch, IHQ of MoD (Army) Delhi Cantt, the selected Medical Officer will undergo 10 days of on-the-job training (OJT) and obtain a certificate from OIC Polyclinic before assuming charge as a contractual employee. This period remains unpaid and is a mandatory requirement before assuming charge.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for ECHS Medical Officer
content_sections.text: Download the prescribed application form from the official website www.echs.gov.in. Fill out the application form completely with verified educational and personal details. Prepare self-attested photocopies of testimonials in support of educational qualifications and work experience. Assemble the application in duplicate copy along with all supporting enclosures. Submit the duplicate application packet to OIC ECHS Cell, 7BRD Air Force Station, Tughlakabad-110080 so that it reaches on or before 12 November 2026. Applications received after 12 November 2026 will not be accepted. Report for the interview at ECHS Polyclinic C/O 7 BRD Air Force Station, Tughlakabad at 1000 hrs on 17 November 2026. For additional details, candidates may contact Station HQ (ECHS Cell) 7 BRD, AF Stn Tughlakabad via telephone at 011-21820078, mobile at 9086846728 or 7016598170, or via email at [email protected] .

content_sections.heading: Documents Required
content_sections.text: Candidates must carry the following documents to the interview venue on 17 November 2026: Original certificates, mark sheets, and degree of 10th / Matric Original certificates and mark sheets of 10+2 Original degree, diploma, course certificates, and mark sheets of Graduation / Post-Graduation Work experience certificates Discharge Book (for Ex-Servicemen) Pension Payment Order (PPO) (for Ex-Servicemen) Service records (for Ex-Servicemen) 01 passport-size colour photograph

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: Preference will be given to Ex-Servicemen (ESM) applicants. Applications received after 12 November 2026 will not be accepted under any circumstances. Candidates must reach the interview venue at ECHS Polyclinic C/O 7 BRD Air Force Station, Tughlakabad by 1000 hrs on 17 November 2026. No TA/DA is admissible for attending the interview. Only candidates meeting the qualitative requirements may apply.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are announced under ECHS Medical Officer recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is 01 contractual vacancy announced for Medical Officer at ECHS Polyclinic, Khanpur.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to submit the application for ECHS Medical Officer?
faq.answer: The last date for receipt of duplicate applications at OIC ECHS Cell, 7BRD Air Force Station, Tughlakabad-110080 is 12 November 2026.

faq.question: Q3. When and where will the walk-in interview take place?
faq.answer: The interview will be held at 1000 hrs on 17 November 2026 at ECHS Polyclinic C/O 7 BRD Air Force Station, Tughlakabad.

faq.question: Q4. What is the required educational qualification for ECHS Medical Officer?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess an MBBS degree along with a minimum of 03 years of work experience after internship. Additional qualifications in Medicine or Surgery are preferred.

faq.question: Q5. What is the monthly remuneration for the post of Medical Officer in ECHS?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a fixed consolidated remuneration of 95,000/- per month.

faq.question: Q6. What is the contract duration for the ECHS Medical Officer post?
faq.answer: The tenure is for one year for ESM and 11 months for civilian candidates, renewable for an additional term subject to performance and maximum age conditions.

faq.question: Q7. Who receives preference in this recruitment?
faq.answer: Preference will be given to Ex-Servicemen (ESM) candidates who meet the qualitative requirements.

faq.question: Q8. Is there any mandatory training required before assuming charge?
faq.answer: Yes, selected candidates must undergo 10 days of unpaid on-the-job training (OJT) and obtain a certificate from the OIC Polyclinic before assuming contractual employment.

faq.question: Q9. Is travel allowance provided for attending the interview?
faq.answer: No, no TA/DA is admissible for appearing at the interview.
